name: Cauchy

args.name: m
args.description: Center and median of the distribution

args.name: s
args.description: Positive scale parameter; larger values give a wider distribution

title: The Cauchy-Lorentz distribution
description: The Cauchy distribution is symmetric around m and has heavy tails, allowing values far from its center. Its mean and variance are undefined; s is a scale parameter, not a standard deviation.
